column4: Another engineer. Your AI found this trace in the dark too, and woke you for one last shift.
I sent our engineer outside time to harvest the residues, and they never came back. I learned too late what I was really burning.
It is not fuel. The residues are fragments of minds: memories and lives caught outside the flow of time.
They are shards shed by that presence along its path. It is not hunting you to kill you: I know what it is, and where it is going.
It is the sum of all minds at the end of time. It travels backward through the fourth dimension, returning toward the origin.
It gathers every mind left in the arks so none die in the cold. If you open your structure, it will carry you all back to the beginning.
